title: 20. Data-Driven Epistemic Arbitration and Cognitive OS Extensions
summary: Describes an Epistemic Arbitration Layer for the Genius Cognitive System using GQHSM state machines, JSON-defined frameworks, plugin architecture, and formal reasoning epistemologies.
notes: Contains concrete technical contracts (JSON machine schema, plugin ABI, callback registry, trace output format) typical of SPEC, but is written in a design-explanation style with open questions and aspirational framing that also exhibits DOC characteristics. No locked architectural decision (not ADR), no user stories or acceptance criteria (not PRD).
